mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate increases the cost of capital for corporations, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 3.5% YoY signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is strong but unemployment (UNRATE) rises, it indicates labor market weakness despite job gains, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., returns are positive in >40% of cases when PAYEMS growth is positive and UNRATE rises).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances following a FEDFUNDS increase.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly HOUST reading below 1500 thousand units signals weak housing demand, indicating economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1500 (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are above their 3-month moving averages, it signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above their 3-month averages fails to produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., returns are negative in >40% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as supply shock regimes, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances following an INDPRO decline.
